title: Sungrow turns to Samsung SDI battery cells to sustain its energy storage business
content:
ungrow plans to procure Samsung SDI battery cells for its energy storage systems, primarily to support continued deliveries to the U.S. market amid tightening restrictions on China-linked supply chains.
The potential three-year, multi-GWh LFP deal could leverage Samsung SDI’s expanding U.S. production footprint, although procurement volumes, manufacturing locations and commercial terms remain undisclosed.

title: From more than 50 GW to under 10 GW: Ukraine doesn’t need its old energy system back
content:
Six air-raid alerts on the first day, backup generators on almost every street corner, and discussions about the rapid reconstruction of severely damaged energy infrastructure: my trip to Kyiv and Lviv showed me why decentralized solar and energy storage are far more than climate technologies for Ukraine. They are part of the country’s security architecture. They also underscore why German solar companies should be engaging with Ukraine today.

title: France’s installed PV capacity hits 34 GW
content:
France connected 3 GW of new solar capacity in the first half of 2026, slightly above the 2.9 GW deployed in the same period of 2025. Large-scale installations above 500 kW accounted for 28% of newly connected capacity, despite representing just 0.3% of new connections. Systems below 9 kW dominated installation numbers, accounting for 78% of new connections but only 8% of added capacity.

The post Franc

title: Italian solar redrew the day, but gas still sets the price
content:
Solar growth softened Italy’s midday power squeeze in summer 2026, but higher heat-driven demand and weaker hydro and wind left gas to cover most of the 7.9 TWh supply gap. The result was a sharper evening exposure: gas generation surged, prices rose most after sunset, and solar-heavy southern zones increasingly faced midday oversupply and weaker capture rates.

title: Sodium-ion storage powers fully off-grid solar home in Germany
content:
A homeowner in Augsburg has paired 270 kWh of BIWATT sodium-ion storage with 49 kWp of solar, creating a fully off-grid household energy system with local distributor SALZSTROM providing the solution.

The post Sodium-ion storage powers fully off-grid solar home in Germany appeared first on pv magazine Global.

title: Reliability risks emerge across BIPV, floating PV and agrivoltaics
content:
A new IEA PVPS Task 13 report identifies distinct reliability risks across BIPV, floating PV and agrivoltaics, from heat and partial shading to wave loads, ammonia exposure and soiling. It argues that existing PV qualification standards do not fully capture these application-specific stresses, requiring adapted testing, design practices and performance metrics.

content:
